subject: Renewal QBR — sprintlet slot brokering and ops windows
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@clearlinehealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal QBR — timing & ops windows

Hi Vivek / Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Were preparing our internal stakeholder availability for the renewal QBR and want to lock a 90–120 minute slot where both product and security can join. Two constraints from our side: the clinical leadership prefers afternoons PT, and procurement wants a short pre-brief (20m) for the contract team the day before.

Can you share a single availability matrix with recommended options (including a backup slot)? Also wed like a compact run-of-show to confirm handoffs.

Attaching our rough calendar snapshot — hope we can finalize by end of this week.

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Director, Platform Partnerships
Clearline Health
[Attachment: clearline_calendar_snapshot.ics (iCal, 1KB)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR — timing & ops windows

Elaine — thanks for the context. I pulled together a short matrix and two candidate windows that respect afternoons PT and the procurement pre-brief ask. See attachment.

Quick summary (high-level):
- Primary: Wed Aug 6, 2025, 1:00–2:30pm PT (product deep-dive + live model demo)
- Backup: Thu Aug 7, 2025, 3:00–4:00pm PT (shortened, exec-focused)
- Procurement pre-brief: Tue Aug 5, 2025, 11:30–11:50am PT (20m)

Operational notes:
- We recommend adding a 10m buffer between the demo and Q&A for any ramp issues.
- If you need recordings disabled, flag it now — recording will be on by default for notes.

Attachments: availability_matrix.csv (CSV, 2KB) — includes attendee lanes (exec, product, security, procurement) and proposed hosts. Also included a compact run-of-show stub (qbr_run_of_show_v1.pdf).

If those windows look reasonable Ill loop in Soojin to set the calendar invites and record logistics (dial-in, recording permissions, test run).

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Renewal Sales, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: availability_matrix.csv (CSV, 2KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR — timing & ops windows

Thanks Vivek — appreciate the options. A couple of practical asks from our side before we finalize: 

1) Executive attendance: If your CEO or CTO want a short 15m exec sync, we can tack that on at the start of the primary slot (0:15). Please confirm names so we can prepare a 3-slide exec summary.
2) Security artifacts: Soojin, can you confirm whether the SOC2 checklist will be ready to surface during the main QBR or only in a follow-up? Elaine, if you want it in the main session well reserve 10m for a security snapshot.
3) Tech dry-run: propose Mon Aug 4, 2025 — 30m window for screenshare and permissions check.

If the above is good, Ill coordinate invites and set the recording permissions as Vivek suggested.

On availability matrix: quick glance — option A looks best for our team but option B gives more exec availability. Elaine, which do you prefer?

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: qbr_run_of_show_v1.pdf (PDF, 35KB)]

From: Elaine Park <elaine@clearlinehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@clearlinehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR — timing & ops windows

Marissa / Vivek — this looks great and thanks for the quick turnaround. A few confirmations: 

- Well take the Primary: Wed Aug 6, 2025, 1:00–2:30pm PT.
- Procurement pre-brief confirmed for Tue Aug 5 at 11:30am PT (Tom will join).
- Exec sync: our VP Product (Aisha Rahman) will join for the first 15m; please prepare the 3-slide summary.
- SOC2 snapshot: please include in the main session for 10m — Soojin, appreciate if you can hold that.
- Tech dry-run OK on Mon Aug 4 at 10:00am PT instead of the 30m window proposed (works better for our engineering team).

Wed like the recording turned on but gated to Clearline attendees only. Also can you add the HubSpot QBR record link to the invite? HubSpot record: HL-3284.

Thanks again — please send calendar invites and DocuSign readiness note if any redlines are expected ahead of the pre-brief.

Best,
Elaine
Director, Platform Partnerships
Clearline Health
